stem:
The domain and range of part of linear function \( r \) are given.

\[ x > 5 \]
\[ y < 2 \]

Which graph could represent this part of linear function \( r \)?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph showing a line segment from (6, 3) to left with an open circle at (6,3)

options.label: B
options.text: Graph showing a line segment from an open circle at (6, 1) going down right

options.label: C
options.text: Graph showing a line segment from (-1, -1) to an open circle at (6, 1)

options.label: D
options.text: Graph showing a line segment from (5, 3) going upwards with a solid start point

visual_elements: Graph A: line segment, open circle (6,3)
Graph B: line segment, open circle (6,1)
Graph C: line segment, open circle (6,1)
Graph D: line segment starting at (5,3) solid
